mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_consume_records (consumer, event_id, status, attempts, consumed_at) VALUES (#{record.consumer}, #{record.eventId}, #{record.status}, #{record.attempts}, #{record.consumedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'consumed', attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, consumed_at = VALUES(consumed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM message_consume_records WHERE consumer = #{consumer} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'consumed'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_consume_records (consumer, event_id, status, attempts, last_error, consumed_at) VALUES (#{consumer}, #{eventId}, 'failed', #{attempts}, #{lastError}, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'failed', attempts = VALUES(attempts), last_error = VALUES(last_error), consumed_at = NULL
